# Calculate positions for L-shaped configuration
# Two square plates: 140x140x10mm each
# They intersect at 90 degrees to form an L-shape

# Plate dimensions
plate_size = 140  # mm
plate_thickness = 10  # mm

# For L-shape, we'll position:
# - First plate: horizontal (base of L)
# - Second plate: vertical (standing part of L)

# First plate (horizontal)
plate1_x = 0
plate1_y = 0
plate1_z = 0
plate1_x_size = plate_size
plate1_y_size = plate_size
plate1_z_size = plate_thickness

# Second plate (vertical) - positioned at the edge of the first plate
plate2_x = 0
plate2_y = 0
plate2_z = plate_thickness  # starts where first plate ends
plate2_x_size = plate_thickness
plate2_y_size = plate_size
plate2_z_size = plate_size

# Square cutout 45x45mm - let's place it on the horizontal plate
cutout_size = 45  # mm
# Center the cutout on the horizontal plate
cutout_x = (plate_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y = (plate_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z = 0  # same base as the plate
cutout_x_size = cutout_size
cutout_y_size = cutout_size
cutout_z_size = plate_thickness  # goes through entire thickness

print(f"Plate 1 (horizontal): position=({plate1_x}, {plate1_y}, {plate1_z}), size=({plate1_x_size}, {plate1_y_size}, {plate1_z_size})")
print(f"Plate 2 (vertical): position=({plate2_x}, {plate2_y}, {plate2_z}), size=({plate2_x_size}, {plate2_y_size}, {plate2_z_size})")
print(f"Cutout: position=({cutout_x}, {cutout_y}, {cutout_z}), size=({cutout_x_size}, {cutout_y_size}, {cutout_z_size})")
